title: Web frontend
description: Web apps with npm: Playwright's browsers in the sandbox on a virtual screen for your app, and a Playwright MCP browser for public pages; npm and GitHub open.

de.title: Web-Frontend
de.description: Web-Apps mit npm: die Browser von Playwright in der Sandbox auf einem virtuellen Bildschirm für Ihre App, und ein Playwright-MCP-Browser für öffentliche Seiten; npm und GitHub offen.

browser.label: Browser MCP server for public pages (sandbox-ai mcp list); empty: none
browser.hint: once: sandbox-ai mcp add playwright --network full

notes: Your app runs in the sandbox (npm run dev at localhost): the agent tests it with Playwright there (npx playwright install chromium; the browsers come from cdn.playwright.dev), and you watch it on the virtual screen (--gui). Chromium's libraries missing: an image variant with them, sandbox-ai images extend claude --add-apt chromium.

The Playwright MCP server runs in a container of its own with the full network: it opens public pages (documentation, a deployed preview), never the sandbox's localhost. Add it once: sandbox-ai mcp add playwright --network full; --preset-value browser= leaves it out. What its pages say is untrusted data.
Pushes: a login during the run (sandbox-ai net allow --git-token-env ...) or the push proxy.
